method: Paired native-culling EEVEE images under identical camera, light and display settings; contact-sheet overview for each model and full-resolution probes of complex details. This is a visual review of the recorded views, not a bound on every possible pose/view.

scope_conclusion: All 45 changed model entries were reviewed in hero and rear before/after images. No newly introduced obvious inverted region, dark hole or wavy surface was observed in those recorded views. Curve/cover facet bands generally improve while original planar and mechanical detail remains.
